units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 15:6">Targ. Y. Gen. XV, 6</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 15b">B. Mets. 15ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>דליקו</he> (<he>דליקום</he>) <he>בהֵימָנוּתֵיה</he> to keep up his reputation for honesty (his credit).
Ib. 86ᵇ לית ה׳ בעבדי no reliance can be placed on servants.—As an affirmation: faith! on my word! Ned. 49ᵇ ה׳ בידא וכ׳ my word in the hand of this woman, i.e. I pledge thee my word.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 38b:20">Snh. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ בידך</he> Ms. M. I assure thee (ed. <he>ה׳ בידן</he> we have the evidence in our hands).—
<cite ref="Shabbat 10b:3">Sabb. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>שרי למימר ה׳ וכ׳</he> it is permitted to say ‘faith!’ in an unclean place, v. <cite ref="E00428"><he>הֵימַן</he></cite>.
